decision_summary: County announced the department ended use of Flock cameras and opted out of its contract after an internal audit found a civilian employee ran personal, non-law-enforcement Flock searches; the employee was fired and resigned, and the matter was referred to an outside agency for criminal investigation. notes: Official county release (via EIN Presswire) says 28 Flock cameras; an AI-generated Sept 1 council-meeting summary says 29 county-controlled cameras were discontinued. Camera count left null pending resolution of the 28/29 conflict. Decision date 2026-08-20 from the official release.
